case_title: RICHARD HARDACK VS. AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $550.00 FILED BY HARDACK, RICHARD AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-03-2020 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF HARDACK, RICHARD AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED DEC-11-2019, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) GARY BOHANNON, FIELD ZONE MANAGER FILED BY DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-03-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-03-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF RICHARD HARDACK IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO., REPRESENTED BY GARY BOHANNON, FIELD ZONE MANAGER IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-03-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HARDACK, RICHARD RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO. $550.00 PRINCIPAL, $45.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $595.00, COURT FINDS DEFENDANT FAILED TO REPAIR TRUNK WHICH OPENED UNEXPECTEDLY WHILE CAR WAS STILL UNDER WARRANTY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN HONDA MOTOR CO.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAY-01-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
